title: Waiver wire risers for week two
excerpt: Three names worth a real bid before Wednesday. Two backfields cracked open, and one slot receiver just became a target hog.
author: FSN Desk
body:
The first Sunday reshuffled more depth charts than usual, and the waiver order tells the story. Here are the three adds that should top your claim sheet.

## The backfield that cracked open

**Jaylen Warren** ran with the first team on every early down after the starter left in the third quarter. Volume like that does not come back to the wire once it lands somewhere, so bid as if he is the lead back. If he is, you paid a fair price. If he is not, you spent a mid tier claim on a flex.

## A target hog hiding in the slot

**Jayden Reed** drew eleven looks from the slot, a rate no one on your bench is matching. Slot volume is sticky. It survives game scripts, weather, and a bad first quarter.

## Hold, do not panic

- Do not cut a starter to make room. Drop the kicker you streamed.
- Prioritize the back over the receiver if you can only win one claim.
- Save a small bid for a defense against a turnover prone offense.

> The wire rewards patience in September, not spending. Keep some budget for the injuries that have not happened yet.
